objective: Isolate whether the frozen V3.2.4 minimum-boundary projection geometry itself tends to create time-unstable LogLoss when the target direction comes from an independent strong pre-match signal. Do not extrapolate the Big-5 V3 model to external leagues.

mechanism.baseline_probability: normalize reciprocal opening average odds AvgH/AvgD/AvgA
mechanism.target_direction: argmax normalize reciprocal closing average odds AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA
mechanism.weak_side: argmin of opening home-vs-away probability only; draw is never weak side
mechanism.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening-probability fallback

evaluation.fold_construction: sort all completed rows by match date then deterministic league/home/away tie-break; split all completed rows into 12 contiguous equal-count folds before reading metric results

diagnostic_classification.GEOMETRY_EXTERNALLY_STABLE: global LL/Brier/RPS nondegrade, Top1 nondegrade, chronological fold LL nondegrade >=10/12, league-season LL nondegrade >=10/12
diagnostic_classification.GEOMETRY_EXTERNALLY_MIXED: global metrics nondegrade but either LL stability count is 7-9/12
diagnostic_classification.GEOMETRY_EXTERNALLY_IMPLICATED: global LL degrades OR either LL stability count <=6/12

interpretation_guards: This is not a V3.2.4 out-of-domain model evaluation.
Closing odds are not added to any football3 model.
This experiment only stress-tests the projection operator using an independent pre-match direction signal.
No result can promote Formal V2, V3.1.1, V3.2.4 or Stage7.
External league results may diagnose projection geometry but cannot substitute for fresh Big-5 confirmation.
